Class JsonStreamWriter

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.json.stream.JsonStreamWriter
public final class JsonStreamWriter extends Object

Writes a document value by value, as UTF-8, compact or pretty as the JsonWriter that created it. It checks the grammar: a value where a member name is expected, a second root value, or an end that does not match its start, is an IllegalStateException.

var writer = new JsonWriter().streamWriter();
writer.beginObject().name("id").value(42).name("tags").beginArray().value("a").endArray().endObject();
byte[] json = writer.toByteArray();

A writer is not thread-safe.

Since:
0.1.0
